WITH g AS (
  SELECT c.SupportRepId AS rep, e.City AS city, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId
  GROUP BY c.SupportRepId, e.City
),
ca AS (
  SELECT city, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM g GROUP BY city
),
j AS (
  SELECT g.rep, g.city, g.cnt, g.cnt * 1.0 / ca.avg_cnt AS ratio_avg
  FROM g JOIN ca ON g.city = ca.city COLLATE BINARY
),
t AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM j
)
SELECT j.rep, j.city, j.cnt, j.ratio_avg, j.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS ratio_total
FROM j JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ratio_total DESC
LIMIT 10
